title: Evaluation Reporting & Telemetry
summary: This module provides utilities for collecting OpenTelemetry spans for tracing and analysis, alongside functions for formatting numerical differences and durations into human-readable strings for evaluation reports.

nodes.label: Collect OpenTelemetry Spans
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry Span Collector
nodes.description: Context manager that captures and organizes OpenTelemetry spans generated during its execution into a `SpanTree` for detailed tracing and analysis. Handles cases where no TracerProvider is configured.

nodes.label: Render Number Differences
nodes.title: Numerical Difference Formatter
nodes.description: Calculates and formats the difference between two numbers (integers or floats), providing both absolute and relative changes (percentages or multipliers) for clear reporting.

nodes.label: Render Duration Differences
nodes.title: Duration Difference Formatter
nodes.description: Formats the difference between two duration values (in seconds), presenting both the absolute time difference and a relative change for performance comparisons.

nodes.label: Render Duration
nodes.title: Duration Formatter
nodes.description: Converts a duration in seconds into a human-readable string, automatically adjusting units (microseconds, milliseconds, seconds) based on the magnitude of the duration.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry System
nodes.title: External OpenTelemetry
nodes.description: An external system or framework that generates OpenTelemetry spans, which are then captured by this module for evaluation.

nodes.label: Evaluation Data
nodes.title: Raw Evaluation Metrics
nodes.description: Raw numerical and duration data resulting from evaluations, which needs to be formatted for reporting purposes.

nodes.label: Formatted Reports
nodes.title: Human-Readable Reports
nodes.description: The final output of the reporting process, consisting of clearly formatted numerical and duration differences suitable for human consumption.

groups.label: Span Collection
groups.title: OpenTelemetry Span Collection
groups.description: Handles the collection and structuring of OpenTelemetry spans for tracing and analysis within evaluation contexts.

groups.label: Reporting & Formatting
groups.title: Numerical & Duration Formatting
groups.description: Provides utilities for formatting numerical differences and durations into human-readable strings for evaluation reports.
